Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

abilities.name: Sanctifying Ring
_curatorNotes: Ring periodic heal authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick heal on the Grass Ring summon (Linnea Memo Heal Aura / Jahoda Robot shape). gcsim skill.go: tick every 90f (1.5s), first tick 90f after ring activation at frame 23 (= spawnsAt) — matches the summonTick firstTickDelay default, so it's omitted. Heal targets c.Core.Player.Active() → target 'active'. TL10: skillhealpp[9]=0.054 (5.4% Max HP) + skillhealflat[9]=635.608 (sidecar '5.4% Max HP+636').

A4 Heart's Repose heal boost (+75% of Shinobu's EM per tick, gcsim a4Healing) co-located on the ring heal via flatScaling per the Aino A4 precedent (DEFAULT_ASCENSION=4 ⇒ A4 active). The manual-trigger stub effects on the Heart's Repose passive node are retained as documentation and do not dispatch.

Ring electro DMG tick authored 2026-07-12 as a summonTick damage effect alongside the heal (Diona Drunken Mist heal+damage pair shape). Same bellTick pulse: gcsim skill.go bellTick queues both the QueueAttack and the Heal every 90f (1.5s), so trigger is identical to the heal's (firstTickDelay omitted = interval default). TL10: skilldot[9]=0.45432 → 45.43% ATK (sidecar 'Grass Ring of Sanctification DMG' col 10 = 45.4%), electro, ICDTag ElementalArt. A4 DMG boost (+25% of Shinobu's EM flat per tick, gcsim a4Damage) co-located via flatScaling, mirroring the heal's A4 treatment (DEFAULT_ASCENSION=4 ⇒ A4 active).
abilities.description:
Creates a Grass Ring of Sanctification at the cost of part of her HP, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Grass Ring of Sanctification
Follows your current active character around. Deals Electro DMG to nearby opponents every 1.5s and restores HP for active character(s) within the ring's AoE based on Kuki Shinobu's Max HP.

The HP consumption from using this skill can only bring her to 20% HP.

abilities.name: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite
_curatorNotes: HP-conditional duration: gcsim uses count=7 ticks (base, ~2s) or count=12 ticks (when HP ≤50%, ~4s from cast), interval=17 frames, burstStart=50. HP condition is not supported by durationModifiers schema (constellation-only). Reviewer to decide representation. gcsim comment notes '11 at low HP' but code sets 12.
Continuous electro DMG effects not authored (field deals electro DMG per tick, scales on Shinobu Max HP). Reviewer to model field tick effects.
abilities.description:
Stabs an evil-excoriating blade into the ground, creating a field that cleanses the area of all that is foul, dealing continuous Electro DMG to opponents within its AoE based on Shinobu's Max HP.
If Shinobu's HP is less than or equal to 50% when this skill is used, the field will last longer.

passives.name: Breaking Free
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — needs reviewer pass. A1: +15% Healing Bonus when Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%. HP-conditional passive with no matching trigger/condition type in the effect schema.
passives.description: When Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%, her Healing Bonus is increased by 15%.

passives.name: Heart's Repose
_curatorNotes: Inherited manual triggers on both effects — actual trigger is onCast (skill), boosting the ring's periodic heal and DMG based on Shinobu's EM for the ring's duration. Reviewer to update triggers and confirm durationType.
passives.description:
Sanctifying Ring's abilities will be boosted based on Shinobu's Elemental Mastery:
·Healing amount will be increased by 75% of Elemental Mastery.
·DMG dealt is increased by 25% of Elemental Mastery.

constellations.description:
When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's Grass Ring of Sanctification hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal AoE Electro DMG based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP.
This effect can occur once every 5s.

constellations.name: To Cease Courtesies
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Ward Weakness
_curatorNotes: Actual trigger is HP-drop-below-25% with a 60s ICD (gcsim onDrain). HP-state conditions aren't modelled in the planner — manual trigger preserved per the HP-state-null-resolving convention.
constellations.description:
When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s.
When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.
